intent.raw: Repair current L0A exact-byte evidence through one explicitly selected SWU before any validation-owner or L0B work.
intent.objective: Restore current L0A contract and diagnostic bytes to immutable receipt handles, prove the existing publication verifier passes without rewriting evidence, then resume the independently owner-gated BTE sequence.
intent.operator_sentence: This dispatch describes later bounded execution; the current refresh selects and executes no SWU.

technique_overlays.trigger: The active plan has one exact-byte repair candidate; later layers remain blocked until current L0A verification and owner handles exist.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Exactly one user-selected SWU receives a strict context pack, exact predecessor/freeze/admission handles, bounded writes, and one terminal receipt before a later route is considered.

technique_overlays.trigger: Core proof spans semantic sources, admissions, validation-owner denominators, generated execution, independent replay, consumers, and lifecycle owners.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: No owner or object may supply a fact owned by another altitude; all six catalogue scopes and both consumer replays must recompose exactly from raw handles.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The current handoff permits only one bounded Task Session SWU; parallelism appears only in later consumer tasks and requires its own user-approved dispatch when reached.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Use local deterministic Task Session execution for one selected SWU. This descriptive plan dispatch does not authorize delegated work.
context: SWU-BTE-L0A-001 is preserved historical pass evidence; current proof is blocked because nine byte surfaces do not reproduce its immutable receipt.
SWU-BTE-L0A-REPAIR-001 is dependency-ready, candidate-only, and unselected; it consumes no red manifest and may change only the nine declared byte surfaces.
SWU-BTE-L0B-001 remains predecessor-and-owner-gated until current L0A publication verification and a matching independent freeze exist.
L7A and L7B may later run in parallel only after one exact green core handle exists and disjoint write scopes are revalidated.
subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: No subagent execution is authorized by this dispatch.

stop_conditions: Zero or more than one SWU is selected
Any consumes, emits, write, negative, stop, or validation obligation is uncovered
A required predecessor, admission, or freeze handle is absent or stale
The candidate task is historical or has no current parent task

steps.name: Fail closed on exact entry handles and write boundaries
stop_conditions: A required handle cannot be resolved and recomputed
The effective write scope overlaps a forbidden or validation-owner source
A planned command is treated as currently runnable before its owning SWU materializes it
The implementation under test can author its expected values or catalogue freeze

steps.name: Execute exactly one selected SWU
stop_conditions: A write leaves the selected SWU allowlist
A preserved source, admission, freeze, expectation, raw result, or historical receipt is rewritten
A validator ignores an unsupported keyword or diagnostic
Any required negative passes for the wrong reason
A receipt, replay, aggregate, or consumer claims authority outside its altitude

steps.name: Independently validate SWU closure and layer recomposition
stop_conditions: The primary behavior or acceptance boundary is incomplete
The receipt cannot be recomputed from raw outputs
The unit does not recompose into its layer exit
A later layer or lifecycle claim is promoted by the bounded result

steps.name: Synchronize the active route from verified receipts
stop_conditions: Plan status would exceed the exact verified receipt
A new SWU is instantiated before its inputs and boundaries are exact
A blocker has no lifecycle scope, owner, and repair path
Craft or Inventory is treated as semantic or execution authority

gates.condition: The L0A-L0B-L1-L8 package, historical map, dispatch, Distill, links, JSON, and preserved handles validate as one coherent state.
The operator selects exactly one current dependency-ready SWU after validation.

Every predecessor, source, context, and write-scope handle required by the selected stage exists and recomputes exactly; the L0A repair requires immutable receipt handles and the nine-path allowlist, while L0B requires current passing publication verification plus a matching validation-owner freeze.
The implementation under test cannot author or rewrite its red manifest, O_spec, expected verdicts/deltas, or catalogue freeze.
